def fn(x):
    # QWERTY order corresponding to alphabet positions 0‑25
    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    res = []
    for ch in x:

            res.append(qwerty[ord(ch) - ord('a')])
        else:
            # keep any other character unchanged
            res.append(ch)
    return ''.join(res)
